title: Web Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
Lee & Nee Softwares (Exports) Ltd. (LNSEL) is a trusted leader in digital transformation with over 36 years of industry experience. The company delivers tailored ERP solutions, impactful digital marketing strategies, and robust web and mobile development services for a diverse client base. LNSEL’s team has successfully completed more than 10,000 projects across 14 countries, reflecting a strong global presence and proven expertise. The organization focuses on understanding each client’s unique needs and providing customized solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. LNSEL offers a collaborative environment for professionals who want to contribute to innovative technology and digital initiatives.

**Role Description**
The Web Content Writer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kolkata. The individual in this role will research industry topics, client offerings, and target audiences to create clear, engaging, and SEO-aware content for websites, blogs, landing pages, and other digital assets. Responsibilities include planning and structuring web pages, drafting and revising copy, aligning content with brand voice and marketing goals, and collaborating closely with designers, developers, and digital marketing teams. The Web Content Writer will help maintain content consistency across platforms, update and improve existing web pages, and support content management activities such as organizing, tagging, and publishing materials. The role calls for attention to detail, adherence to deadlines, and proactive communication within a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Web Content Writing and Writing skills for creating clear, user-focused digital copy.
* Candidates should possess Content Strategy and Content Management skills to plan, organize, and maintain web content effectively.
* Candidates should possess solid Research skills to gather accurate information about products, services, competitors, and industry trends.
* Strong command of English grammar, style, and readability, with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences and sectors.
* Familiarity with SEO principles, web analytics basics, and best practices for digital marketing content is beneficial.
* Experience working with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress or similar) and coordinating with design and development teams is an advantage.
* Relevant academic background in Communications, English, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and collaborate within a diverse, inclusive team environment.

title: Cyber security intern
description:
**Company Description**
Weskill is an innovative online training platform focused on upskilling undergraduate students through practical, career-oriented learning. The organization designs hands-on programs that bridge the gap between academic curricula and real-world corporate expectations. Learners gain exposure to skills and tools commonly used in high-growth startups and established multinational companies. By emphasizing applied knowledge and industry readiness, Weskill helps learners build strong professional foundations and competitive profiles for future roles.

**Role Description**
The Cyber Security Intern role at Weskill is a remote internship focused on learning and contributing to foundational security tasks. On a day-to-day basis, the intern may assist with monitoring systems for potential security issues, documenting incidents, and supporting basic vulnerability assessments under supervision. The intern will help research emerging threats, review security best practices, and contribute to security awareness materials or documentation. This role also involves collaborating with mentors and team members, participating in training sessions, and completing assigned projects designed to build practical cyber security skills.

**Qualifications**

* Interest in cyber security concepts such as network security, application security, and threat detection.
* Basic familiarity with operating systems (Windows, Linux) and common networking fundamentals.
* Ability to research technical topics, analyze information, and document findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and a structured approach to tasks.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and willingness to collaborate in a remote environment.
* Current enrollment in an undergraduate program in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent self-directed learning).
* Interest in developing skills with security tools, frameworks, or certifications (e.g., introductory cyber security courses) is a plus.

title: Sustainability-Workviva-Senior

title: ERP Functional Specialist
description:
**ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist**

**Salary: 60K Per Month**

**Experience: 4- 6 yrs**

**Working Days: 05**

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**
who can analyse our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

●      
**Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**
Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.

●      
**Workflow & SOP Management:**
Design, map, and optimise end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.

●      
**Functional Solution Design:**
Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilised effectively before requesting custom development.

●      
**Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**
Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritise the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on what to build and
*why*
.

●      
**Testing & Quality Assurance:**
Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.

●      
**ERPNext Configuration:**
Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).

●      
**User Training & Support:**
Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.

●      
**Cross-functional Collaboration:**
Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

●      
**Experience:**
4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.

●      
**Industry Knowledge:**
Proven, extensive background in the
**manufacturing industry**
, with specific experience handling the complexities of
**high-volume manufacturing**
(production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).

●      
**Product Management Skills:**
Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.

●      
**Functional Expertise:**
Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.

●      
**Process Mapping:**
Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.

●      
**Analytical Skills:**
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge cases and incorporate them into system designs.

●      
**Soft Skills:**
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.

●      
**Execution-Oriented:**
A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

●      
**AI for Productivity & Coding:**
Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
**Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**
) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: Strategy Associate – Infrastructure & Operations
description:
**Strategy Associate – Infrastructure & Operations**

**Department:**

CEO’s Office

**Location:**

Kolkata, West Bengal

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Experience:**

Minimum 5 years

**Compensation:**

Up to ₹10 LPA

**Qualification:**

MBA in FinTech

**Role Overview**

India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum and their families.

We are looking for a Strategy Associate to strengthen the monitoring and evaluation of organisational strategy, with a specialist focus on infrastructure development, finance, procurement, technology, administration, and campus operations.

Working with leadership, the role will assess progress against agreed objectives, budgets, resource requirements, quality standards, and timelines. You will play a key role in analysing performance, identifying implementation gaps and emerging risks, recommending improvements, and tracking agreed corrective actions.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Strategic Performance Monitoring**

* Monitor departmental plans, projects, and organisation-wide strategic priorities against agreed deliverables, milestones, quality parameters, budgets, resource requirements, and timelines.
* Review progress across infrastructure development, construction, procurement, campus operations, administration, IT, and finance.
* Identify deviations from approved plans, analyse underlying causes, and flag delays, cost variances, resource constraints, and implementation bottlenecks.
* Maintain performance trackers and monitor the completion of agreed actions by accountable teams.

**2. Strategic Evaluation & Review**

* Conduct structured, evidence-based reviews of projects, departments, and strategic initiatives to assess progress, effectiveness, efficiency, and adherence to approved plans.
* Examine project schedules, budgets, procurement processes, expenditure trends, resource utilisation, dependencies, and delivery milestones, as applicable.
* Analyse recurring gaps, delays, cost overruns, process weaknesses, and deviations from established standards.
* Prepare findings and practical recommendations for the relevant leadership.
* Coordinate internal review and audit activities, document observations, and track corrective and preventive actions through closure.

**3. Policies, Systems & Process Implementation**

* Identify organisational needs and process gaps and support the development of appropriate systems, structures, policies, workflows, SOPs, and accountability mechanisms.
* Monitor the implementation and adoption of established systems across relevant departments.
* Review procurement workflows, project reporting mechanisms, financial controls, administrative processes, and operational systems for effectiveness and consistency.
* Identify duplication, inefficiencies, and gaps in implementation and recommend improvements in consultation with the relevant teams.

**4. Risk Monitoring & Management**

* Maintain and periodically review relevant organisational and project risk registers.
* Monitor identified risks relating to construction, procurement, budgets, resources, timelines, operational readiness, and interdepartmental dependencies.
* Track mitigation plans, identify emerging risks, and escalate material concerns or unresolved issues to the Strategy Lead.
* Monitor whether agreed mitigation measures are implemented within the specified timelines.

**5. Leadership Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Consolidate data from projects and departments into accurate dashboards, management reports, review presentations, and analytical summaries.
* Analyse performance trends across cost, quality, timelines, resource utilisation, and operational readiness.
* Provide evidence-based insights into recurring challenges, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve institutional effectiveness.
* Support periodic departmental and organisation-wide strategic reviews.

**6. Cross-functional Coordination & Accountability**

* Work with project owners, department heads, and relevant teams to review progress and understand implementation challenges.
* Follow up on agreed actions, document ownership and deadlines, and monitor timely resolution.
* Identify dependencies and bottlenecks across infrastructure, finance, procurement, IT, administration, and campus operations.
* Escalate persistent deviations and unresolved issues through the established reporting structure.

**Key Outcomes**

* Reliable visibility into the progress, cost, quality, resource requirements, and timelines of key projects and organisational priorities.
* Early identification of implementation gaps, project risks, and operational readiness issues.
* Evidence-based evaluation of departmental and project performance.
* Stronger implementation and adoption of organisational systems, processes, and controls.
* Timely follow-through on agreed corrective actions.
* High-quality management reporting that supports informed leadership decisions.

**Must-have Requirements**

* 5 years of relevant experience in project monitoring, business analysis, operations, financial analysis, procurement, infrastructure projects, or management reporting.
* MBA in FinTech.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse plans, budgets, timelines, performance data, and operational processes.
* Experience preparing reports, maintaining trackers, identifying implementation gaps, and following up on corrective actions.
* Strong analytical, organisational, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, dashboards, and management reporting tools.
* Ability to work across multiple departments and manage competing priorities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to construction or infrastructure projects, procurement, budgeting, or campus operations.
* Familiarity with project management tools, financial controls, workflow systems, and risk registers.
* Experience in healthcare, education, non-profit, social-impact, or other multi-stakeholder organisations.
* Understanding of process improvement, internal controls, and project evaluation methodologies.

**About India Autism Center**

India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of life for individuals and families across India.

title: Business and Growth Intern
description:
Business & Growth Intern

Duration: 6 Months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Kolkata

Company: PopLotus (Nutralike Superfoods Pvt. Ltd.)

Role Summary

PopLotus is a growing Indian snacking brand focused on building the next generation of premium, better-for-you makhana products. As a Business & Growth Intern, you will work closely with the core team across multiple functions of the business and gain hands-on exposure to how a consumer brand is built and scaled.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role designed for someone who wants to understand the complete business rather than work within a single function. Your responsibilities will span e-commerce and quick commerce, exports and foreign trade, business analytics, marketing and brand building, general trade, logistics, and HR/business operations.

You will be expected to take ownership of projects, work with data, identify opportunities, coordinate with external partners, and contribute directly to business decisions.

What Success Looks Like
  

Success in this role means becoming someone the core team can rely on to independently take a problem, analyse it, execute a solution, and measure the outcome.

By the end of the internship, you should have developed a strong understanding of how a consumer/FMCG business operates across online, offline, domestic and international channels, while having contributed tangible results to PopLotus' growth.

Responsibilities
  

* Support the growth and management of PopLotus across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms, including marketplace operations, catalogue management, pricing, promotions, inventory and platform performance.
* Analyse sales, customer, SKU and channel-level data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Assist in developing and maintaining data-driven dashboards and reports to track sales, margins, inventory, channel performance and other key business metrics.
* Support foreign trade and export development, including identifying potential buyers and distributors, researching international markets, generating leads, coordinating samples, and assisting with export documentation and follow-ups.
* Research international markets data to identify potential opportunities for Indian makhana and better-for-you snacking products, including competitor, pricing and market analysis.
* Contribute to brand building and marketing initiatives, including campaign planning, content coordination, market research, consumer insights and competitor tracking.
* Assist in expanding PopLotus' general trade and distribution network, including distributor research, retailer mapping, lead generation, outreach and sales coordination.
* Develop an understanding of the Indian makhana and FMCG snacking ecosystem, including sourcing, grades, pricing, competitors, distribution models and consumer trends.
* Coordinate with logistics partners, warehouses, vendors and internal teams to support inventory movement, order fulfilment, dispatches and operational efficiency.
* Assist with vendor and partner coordination across different business functions and ensure timely follow-ups and execution.
* Support HR and people operations, including recruitment coordination, candidate screening, onboarding, intern coordination and other day-to-day HR activities.
* Conduct market and competitor research across products, brands, pricing, distribution, consumer behaviour and emerging trends.
* Take ownership of ad-hoc strategic and operational projects that contribute to the growth and development of PopLotus.
* Work closely with the founding/core team and provide regular updates on project progress, findings, challenges and recommendations.

Qualifications
  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Management, Commerce, Economics, Marketing, Finance or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to work comfortably with numbers and data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets; familiarity with data analysis and dashboards is an advantage.
* Strong research skills and the ability to independently find, interpret and present information.
* Interest in FMCG, D2C brands, e-commerce, quick commerce, exports, consumer businesses or startups.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where responsibilities can evolve quickly.
* Proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, vendors, distributors, logistics partners and other external stakeholders.

What You Will Gain

* Hands-on exposure to building and scaling an FMCG consumer brand from the ground up.
* Exposure to e-commerce, quick commerce, general trade and international markets.
* Practical experience in exports and foreign trade.
* Experience working with real business data and making data-driven decisions.
* Direct interaction with founders and senior stakeholders.
* Cross-functional exposure across sales, marketing, operations, logistics, analytics and HR.
* An opportunity to take ownership of projects with measurable business impact.

title: CHM Senior Associate
description:
Job Title: CHM Senior Associate
  
  
Req ID: 64496
  
  
Job Function: Service
  
  
Posting Start Date: 11/11/2026
  
  
Posting End Date: 18/11/2026
  
  
Division: BT International
  
  
Job Location: IND-Rajarhat-DLF IT
  
  
Advertised Salary: Competitive
  
  
**Job Req ID: 64496**
**Posting Date: 11-Nov-26**
**Function: Service**
**Location: Kolkata/Gurugram**
**Salary: Competitive**
**About The Role**
The Change Management Senior Associate plays a key role within the Global Change Management Centre of Excellence, ensuring changes to live customer environments are properly assessed, authorised, communicated and implemented with minimal risk.
  
  
This role supports BT’s commitment to reliable services by governing change activity throughout its lifecycle, coordinating with technical teams, customers, suppliers and stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with ITIL best practice. The role contributes directly to service stability, risk reduction, customer experience and operational excellence.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage change requests throughout the complete change lifecycle.
* Review and validate Requests for Change (RFCs), including impact assessment, testing evidence, implementation plan and rollback plan.
* Ensure all changes comply with BT policies, customer requirements and ITIL best practice.
* Coordinate approvals through internal and external Change Advisory Boards (CABs).
* Chair CAB meetings and facilitate informed decisions where required.
* Assess risks associated with planned, standard, expedited and emergency changes.
* Work with internal teams, customers, suppliers and project stakeholders to support smooth change implementation.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date change records and supporting documentation.
* Monitor scheduled change activity and follow up with delivery teams before, during and after implementation.
* Support post-implementation reviews for failed or unsuccessful changes.
* Ensure customer communication and validation activity is completed after implementation.
* Produce operational and management reports to support service governance and performance review.
* Help prevent unauthorised changes and promote strong governance controls across customer environments.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that improve service stability and change success rates.
* Collaborate across teams to deliver a consistent customer experience.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* 4 to 7 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in Change Management.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Change Enablement / Change Management practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification, preferably ITIL v4.
* Experience in large-scale IT, telecommunications, managed services or infrastructure environments.
* Knowledge of network, security, cloud and enterprise technology environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and customer engagement skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to assess risk and make informed governance decisions.
* Experience using service management and workflow tools.
* Strong organisation and time-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Able to work across global time zones and within a 24x7 operational model.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Commitment to quality, compliance and continuous improvement.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**

* Previous experience chairing CAB meetings.
* Exposure to customer infrastructure services and telecom environments.
* Team leadership or mentoring experience.
* Knowledge of planned maintenance governance and third-party supplier management.
* Understanding of Agile governance practices.
* Knowledge of an additional European language, such as German, French or Swedish.

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: ServiceNow -Dev -Senior
description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Key Responsibilities
  
Business Analysis & PRD Creation: Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
  
Workflow & SOP Management: Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
  
Functional Solution Design: Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
  
Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management: Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on what needs to be built and why.
  
Testing & Quality Assurance: Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
  
ERPNext Configuration: Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
  
User Training & Support: Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
  
Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.
  
Candidate Requirements
  
Experience: 4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
  
Industry Knowledge: Proven, extensive background in the manufacturing industry, with specific experience handling the complexities of high-volume manufacturing (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
  
Product Management Skills: Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
  
Functional Expertise: Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
  
Process Mapping: Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
  
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
  
Soft Skills: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
  
Execution-Oriented: A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.
  
Added Advantage (Nice to Have)
  
AI for Productivity & Coding: Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.
  
What We Value We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: IT Solutions Analyst (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India)
description:
The
**IT Solutions Analyst - ServiceNow**
is the functional and technical bridge between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting solutions across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
  
  
This role translates customer service, asset management, contracts management, and entitlement-related requirements into scalable ServiceNow workflows, custom applications, and integrations. The analyst partners with Sales, Field Service, Customer Care, Manufacturing, and other IT teams to improve customer experience, order accuracy, and service efficiency, and acts as a subject-matter expert and escalation point for production support. As part of the IT Enterprise Applications team, the analyst also designs and supports integrations between ServiceNow and other systems, including Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Requirements analysis and solution design**

* Gather, document, and refine business requirements through workshops, interviews, and process mapping with Sales, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Finance stakeholders.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, and solution designs aligned to ServiceNow best practices.
* Assess the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, and recommend out-of-the-box (OOTB) approaches over customization where practical.

**Platform configuration and development**

* Configure and enhance CSM (case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, knowledge management).
* Configure and enhance MCO and SOM (product and quote catalogs, order capture, decomposition and fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and commercial and manufacturing operations workflows).
* Design and build custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder / Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony, and other enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement and tune ServiceNow AI features (Now Assist skills, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Build Agent) across CSM, MCO, and SOM processes, and measure their impact on case deflection, resolution time, and agent productivity.

**Testing, deployment, and release management**

* Develop test plans and test cases, execute functional and regression testing, and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Manage update sets / application repository deployments across instances and follow established change, release, and source-control practices.
* Produce release notes, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.

**Production support and continuous improvement**

* Provide Tier 2/3 support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident triage, root-cause analysis, and permanent fixes within SLA targets.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and performance, and proactively identify and close process or configuration gaps.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, and technical debt reduction.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, and process flows; contribute to the product backlog and sprint planning.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Work with architects, developers, and platform owners to uphold standards for security, ACLs, data governance, and compliance.
* Report on solution adoption and process KPIs (case resolution time, order cycle time, SLA attainment) using Performance Analytics and dashboards.
* Mentor junior analysts and share knowledge across the ServiceNow community of practice.

****All About You****
We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
  
  
****Education And Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer, focused specifically on ServiceNow solutions.
* Demonstrated implementation and support experience in at least two of the three target modules: CSM, MCO, and SOM.
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements through deployment and support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, upgrades, and release cycles.

**ServiceNow certifications**
**Certification**
**Requirement**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Required**
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Sales and Order Management (SOM)
  
  
Optional (preferred)
  
  
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  
  
**Required**
Candidates holding certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or comparable manufacturing-industry ServiceNow credentials will be given strong preference.
  
  
****Technical Skills****

* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow data model, tables, ACLs, roles, and CMDB / Customer Service data structures.
* Proficiency with JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Experience with integrations to Salesforce, on-premise applications, and databases (SQL, JDBC) using REST/SOAP, Integration Hub spokes, MID Server, and import sets / transform maps.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM (case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation), Now Assist Virtual Agent, AI Search, and customizing skills with Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI on the platform, including features available through the Australia release: building, configuring, and governing AI Agents and agentic workflows, selecting model providers (Now LLM Service or third-party models), and managing Now Assist administration, licensing tiers, and guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces (Customer Service Workspace).
* Understanding of order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement, and warranty / contract processes.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum / SAFe) delivery, user story writing, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to write functional specifications, test cases, and process documentation, and to present solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Hands-on MCO experience, including manufacturing commercial processes such as contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions, such as ServiceNow Sales and Order Management quoting, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order flows, and integration with order management and ERP systems (a strong advantage).
* Additional ServiceNow certifications: Certified Technical Architect (in progress), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist / Generative AI / Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience building custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create agentic workflows for custom applications, and keeping pace with new AI capabilities in each ServiceNow family release.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP (Oracle Fusion), CRM (Salesforce), PLM, or MES systems.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control for ServiceNow (for example, Git integration, ATF automated testing).
* Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Prior experience coordinating large/small projects or mentoring junior team members.

****Core Skills And Working Conditions****
**Core skills**

* Analytical and problem-solving ability, with a bias toward root-cause resolution over workarounds.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including facilitating workshops and explaining technical concepts to business users.
* Stakeholder management and the ability to balance multiple priorities across commercial, service, and manufacturing teams.
* Customer-centric mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and user adoption.
* Ownership, attention to detail, and comfort being self-directed in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
* Collaboration with onshore and offshore development partners.

**Working conditions**

* Primarily remote-based, with occasional travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production issues and occasional after-hours release or upgrade support.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

* Demonstrated experience with APQP, PPAP, NPI, Problem Solving and customer quality management

* Results-oriented, data-driven, and committed to operational excellence

title: Academy AF A ContentAggregator
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior content aggregation specialist within the Academy AF A function designing and operating robust hybrid solutions that unify learning data and digital assets from diverse enterprise and external sources. Apply expertise in Net SQL Python and modern generative AI platforms including Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to curate classify and expose high quality training content. Deliver reliable day shift outcomes that elevate organizational capability and societal impact through ac
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain scalable content aggregation workflows that collect normalize and classify learning materials from internal repositories and approved external sources to ensure a unified and reliable Academy catalog.
* Develop and optimize Net based services and APIs that securely expose aggregated content to front end applications and downstream platforms while maintaining high performance and reliability.
* Create robust Python scripts and automation routines to process metadata perform text transformation and orchestrate batch ingestion jobs that keep the content library current and comprehensive.
* Use SQL to design efficient data models queries and procedures that support fast retrieval advanced filtering and detailed reporting across the consolidated learning content store.
* Apply Gemini AI to generate insightful summaries recommend relevant learning paths and enrich metadata so that employees can quickly discover material that supports their growth and productivity.
* Apply Claude capabilities to analyze long form learning content extract key concepts and improve instructional clarity enhancing the overall quality and accessibility of Academy assets.
* Apply Open AI models to enable personalized content suggestions conversational search and adaptive learning experiences that improve engagement and skill acquisition for diverse learners.
* Collaborate closely with instructional designers and subject matter experts to validate aggregated content refine taxonomies and ensure alignment with enterprise learning objectives and compliance standards.
* Implement robust data quality checks observability metrics and issue resolution routines that minimize broken links duplicate records and outdated material across hybrid content pipelines.
* Document aggregation processes data flows and integration patterns in clear operational guides that enable consistent day shift support and smooth handoffs among distributed team members.
* Coordinate with platform engineers and security specialists to ensure that all integrations data movements and AI workloads comply with governance requirements and protect sensitive information.
* Monitor usage analytics feedback signals and content performance indicators to propose targeted improvements that enhance learning outcomes and amplify the impact of Academy programs on society.
* Drive continuous refinement of hybrid work practices using collaboration tools and structured communication methods so that onsite and remote team members deliver cohesive and predictable content services.

**Qualifications**

* Bring seven to eleven years of experience working with enterprise grade content or data platforms demonstrating accountability for end to end aggregation curation and delivery outcomes in complex environments.
* Show advanced proficiency in Net application development with emphasis on building secure and modular services that integrate seamlessly with databases APIs and generative AI platforms.
* Demonstrate strong SQL skills in designing normalized schemas writing optimized queries and tuning data workloads to support analytics reporting and rapid content discovery.
* Exhibit deep Python expertise in building automation frameworks data processing utilities and integration scripts that manage large volumes of structured and unstructured learning materials.
* Provide hands on experience working with Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to design practical solutions for summarization classification recommendation and conversational access to learning content.
* Offer a track record of operating effectively in hybrid work models by using digital collaboration tools documenting workflows and maintaining consistent communication during standard day shifts.
* Prefer prior exposure to corporate learning ecosystems or digital education platforms where content aggregation curation standards and learner centric experiences were central responsibilities.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified Net Developer and Microsoft Certified Azure Data Engineer or equivalent cloud data qualification relevant to SQL and Python.

The role involves managing export sales, generate sales leads, documentation, including preparing invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, shipping documents, and compliance records in line with international trade regulations. The Export Manager will coordinate with freight forwarders, customs agents, and logistics partners to ensure timely shipment and delivery of leather goods. Daily responsibilities include handling international sales inquiries, preparing quotations, negotiating terms with overseas buyers, and maintaining strong customer relationships. The role also includes tracking orders, monitoring payments, maintaining export records, and collaborating with production and quality teams to meet delivery schedules and customer specifications.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in export sales, generating leads and doing export documentation, including preparation of commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping documents, and regulatory compliance records.
* Candidates should possess skills in international sales and customer management, such as handling inquiries, negotiating terms, preparing quotations, and building long-term client relationships.
* Candidates should possess skills in logistics coordination and supply chain support, including working with freight forwarders, customs agents, and tracking shipments and deliveries.
* Candidates should possess skills in basic financial and commercial understanding, including knowledge of pricing, payment terms, Incoterms, and export-related costs.
* Candidates should possess skills in communication and organization, including clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, time management, and record-keeping.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, international trade, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in export operations, documentation, or international sales, ideally in manufacturing or leather goods, is highly beneficial.
* Knowledge of export regulations, customs processes, and relevant software or ERP systems will be an advantage.

* Demonstrate the right-ways of to capture and validate data lineage documentation
* Map data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems

**Quality Assurance**

* Perform QA reviews of team deliverables to ensure client expectations on delivery quality are met

**Collaboration & Support**

* Ability to work across Regulatory Reporting, Finance, Risk, Data Office and IT
* Provide functional support to all phases of delivery (Sprints, Testing, Hypercare etc.)
* Ability to guide and coach junior team members

**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* 4-9 years of experience in data used for risk, financial and supervisory reporting within the broader data governance context, with right mix of practical lineage capability and strong analytical, investigative, documentation and stakeholder-management skills
* Working experience in Capital Adequacy and Risk Exposures (any 1 or more subject areas of  capital adequacy, own funds, credit risk, market risk, operational risk, leverage, liquidity metrics, large exposures, asset encumbrance)
* Working experience in:

+ Source-system analysis and data extraction processes
+ Mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems
+ Automation of lineage capture and documentation activities
+ Data catalogue, metadata repository and reporting architecture initiatives
+ Identification of report owners, critical data elements and reporting metrics
+ Documentation and validation of end-to-end reporting lineage
+ Maintenance of reporting inventories, controls and governance documentation
+ Coordination with Data Office, Finance, Risk Management and other stakeholders
+ Good to have:

- Support during regulatory reviews and onsite inspections
- IFRS 9 ECL Models

- Documentation of model dependencies, assumptions, controls, reconciliations, governance, validation and approvals

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education**
:
  
  

* Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As part of our EY GDS-Utilities team, you will work to implement and support SAP IS-U projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problems.
  
  
We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in SAP FI-CA to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* To provide functional knowledge with hands-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)
* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning procedure/Collection Strategy, payment (cash desk/external cash desk) integration with payment channels, write off, return processing, security deposit, installment plan, and promise to pay.
* Exposure of Country specific localization.
* Experience in BRIM CI FICA is good to have.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF+ (functional).
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support.
* Gather and prioritize relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests
* Should be well versed to make enhancements in specific FICA events.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:
* Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
* Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: DOMAIN ARCHITECT L1
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**
The purpose of the role is overall development of the target Architecture through defining the technology roadmap for own business/ domain. Recognized as the subject matter expert for a specific domain and provides expert advice & guidance to different business stakeholders 

͏

**Do**

* **Develop architectural application for the new deals/ major change requests in existing deals**
  + Creates enterprise wide business/ domain architecture deliverables (enabling, diagnostic and actionable) focused on the target audience and its issues and opportunities
  + Look for opportunities to use high-level business and operating models (business capability and value chain), combined with or relating to business, people, information, technology and solutions.
  + Contributes to the Target Architecture, by developing and maintaining the technology roadmap for area of expertise and ensuring that roadmap remains aligned to the Business Strategy
  + Recognizing innovative use of technology for increasing performance measures
  + Works with other IS and business stakeholders to drive the development and adoption of the target architecture for own domain
  + Establish domain specific standards, near/mid-term strategy, and roadmaps, in adherence to, and in support of Enterprise standards, strategy, and roadmaps.
  + Guide a solution from concept to delivery - envision and create solutions that meet requirements
  + Prove the feasibility of a design; and can ultimately be implemented and supported in the Production environment
  + Oversee product/ platform engineering, protocol map development, virtualization as per the business solution requirements
  + Apply architectural and engineering concepts to design a solution that meets operational requirements, such as scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, extensibility, flexibility, availability, and manageability.
  + Participate and lead research and development efforts (proof of concept, prototypes), as subject matter experts, when introducing new technologies, in conjunction with team and Product Owners

͏

* Partners with IT and line of business functional groups to communicate and clarify business needs, contributes to the development of long-range system plans, and ensures that IT products, services and processes are aligned with line of business needs.
* Define high-level migration plans to address the gaps between the current and future state, typically in sync with the IT budgeting or other capital planning processes
* Provides technology consulting to solution architects, junior staff members, and others who are using or modifying multiple domain technologies within a solution, insuring the technology operates coherently to meet overall needs
* Interaction with EA, OEMs, Technical leads for defining business solutions
* Depending on the client s need with particular standards and technology stacks create complete RFPs
* Clearly articulate and sell architectural targets, recommendations and reusable patterns and accordingly propose investment roadmaps
* Provide solution of RFP s received from clients and ensure overall design assurance
  + Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of all the business/ domain requirements including systems, shared infrastructure services in order to better match business outcome objectives
  + Analyse technology environment, enterprise specifics, client requirements to set a collaboration solution for the big/small data
  + Provide technical leadership to the implementation of custom solutions through thoughtful use of modern technology
  + Define and understand current issues and problems and identify improvements
  + Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate with overall technology ecosystem keeping consistency throughout
  + Understand the root cause problem in integrating business and product units
  + Validate the solution/ prototype from technology, cost structure and customer differentiation point of view
  + Collaborating with sales and delivery leadership teams to identify future needs and requirements
  + Tracks industry and application trends and relates these to planning current and future IT needs

͏

* **Understanding enterprise requirements and provide solutions for technical ecosystem**
  + Creating Intellectual Property in forms of services, patterns, models and organizational approaches.
  + Bring knowledge of automation in application by embracing Agile and dev-ops principles to reduce manual part
  + Responsible for successfully applying the technology in their domain to solve business problems in a supportable, cost effective, way
  + Analyze the current technology environment to detect critical deficiencies and recommend solutions for improvement. In addition, analyze the technology industry and market trends to determine their potential impact on the enterprise as well as on the enterprise technology architecture
  + Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be-solutions including systems, shared infrastructure services, applications in order to better match business outcome objectives
  + Provide platform to create standardize tools, uniform design and techniques are maintained to reduce costs of maintenance
  + Seamless integration and advising of new and existing systems to eliminate potential problems and maintain data structure and bring value in terms of development
  + Serve as technical owner and point of contact for domain specific solutions and provide technical leadership to the design, development and implementation of custom solutions through thoughtful use of modern technology

͏

* **Enable Delivery Teams by providing optimal delivery solutions/ frameworks**
  + Build and maintain relationships with executives, technical leaders, product owners, peer architects and other stakeholders to become a trusted advisor
  + Collaborate with enterprise architect for translating business strategy to execution
  + Develops and establishes relevant technical, business process and overall support metrics (KPI/SLA) to drive results
  + Bring value in terms of quality in development activities by leveraging cloud based and scalable infrastructure
  + Identify technical, process, structural risks and prepare a risk mitigation plan for all the projects
  + Ensure quality assurance of all the architecture or design decisions and provides technical mitigation support to the delivery teams
  + Recommend tools for reuse, automation for improved productivity and reduced cycle times
  + Leads the development and maintenance of enterprise framework and related artefacts
  + Develops trust and builds effective working relationships through respectful, collaborative engagement across individual product teams
  + Provide architectural oversight of projects; ensure requirements are in alignment with business strategies and business architecture roadmap/framework.
  + Ensure solutions developed across organization are aligned to enterprise architecture standards and principles, leverage common solutions and services, and meet financial targets (cost and benefits).
  + Negotiate, manage and coordinate with the client teams to ensure all requirements are met and create an impact of solution proposed
  + Demonstrate thought leadership with strong technical capability in front of the client to win the confidence and act as a trusted advisor

Guidewire ClaimCenter

NA

Summary:
  
  
As a Business Architect, a typical day involves identifying opportunities that can bring measurable business value by thoroughly evaluating the existing environment. The role includes gathering and documenting high-level requirements and designing effective business solutions that align with organizational goals. This position requires translating complex business needs into technology-driven solutions and operational frameworks. Additionally, the Business Architect supports organizational transformation by preparing detailed business cases and providing guidance throughout the implementation of critical initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and fostering continuous improvement.

Eligibility Criteria:

title: Technical / Sourcing Merchandiser
description:
**About Chase Labs**

At Chase Labs, we aspire to build and power a global portfolio of retail brands, driven by our expertise in data-led product design and an innovative, technology-enabled supply chain.

With a strong focus on innovation, creativity, and operational excellence, we are continuously exploring new ways to transform the fashion and retail landscape while moving towards a more sustainable future.

Our brand portfolio includes Miss Chase, Dolce Crudo, Miss Chase A+, Life with Pockets, House of Denim, and other emerging labels.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a knowledgeable, detail-oriented, and technically sound
**Technical / Sourcing Merchandiser**
to manage the sourcing, development, and commercialisation of fabrics and trims from concept to production.

The role requires a strong understanding of textiles, fabric construction, trims, garment construction, dyeing, finishing, printing, and testing processes. The candidate will act as a key link between the design, merchandising, quality, production, and sourcing teams, as well as external suppliers and vendors, ensuring that all developments meet the required quality, cost, aesthetic, and performance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Fabric & Trim Sourcing and Development**

* Collaborate with design, buying, and product development teams to understand fabric and trim requirements and translate creative concepts into commercially viable materials.
* Source and develop fabrics and trims across multiple product categories, specifications, and price points.
* Identify and evaluate suitable mills, suppliers, and vendors through market visits and sourcing activities.
* Explore new materials, suppliers, and manufacturing capabilities to strengthen the sourcing network.

**2. Technical Development & Approvals**

* Coordinate the development and approval of lab dips, strike-offs, print samples, trims, and other material submissions.
* Ensure all fabric and trim developments meet the required aesthetic, technical, and performance specifications.
* Coordinate fabric and trim testing, evaluate test reports, and facilitate third-party certifications wherever required.
* Work closely with suppliers to resolve technical issues and ensure approved standards are maintained during bulk production.

**3. Critical Path & Production Coordination**

* Track fabric, trim, and garment development progress in coordination with internal teams.
* Ensure timely submission of samples, test reports, approvals, and bulk materials.
* Coordinate with mills and suppliers to ensure adherence to agreed delivery schedules.
* Proactively identify development or production bottlenecks and work towards timely resolution.

**4. Costing & Commercial Management**

* Support fabric and trim costing activities and negotiate prices with suppliers to achieve target costs and margins.
* Evaluate sourcing options based on quality, cost, lead time, and supplier capabilities.
* Work closely with internal teams to ensure cost-effective material selection without compromising quality.

**5. Vendor Management & Documentation**

* Build and maintain effective working relationships with domestic and international mills, suppliers, and vendors.
* Maintain accurate records of vendors, sourcing activities, orders, fabric and trim developments, print submissions, lab dips, and approval status.
* Ensure proper documentation and systematic maintenance of all material specifications, test reports, and approvals.
* Monitor market developments, new textile technologies, sustainability practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.

**Requirements & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Textile Engineering, Fabric Technology, Apparel Merchandising, or a related discipline.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in technical merchandising, fabric sourcing, product development, or purchasing.
* Strong technical knowledge of textiles, including fibres, yarns, fabric construction, dyeing, finishing, and fabric/trim testing standards.
* Good understanding of garment construction, fit, and grading.
* Practical knowledge of woven and knitted prints, machine embroidery, and surface embellishments is essential.
* Understanding of fabric and garment quality parameters and performance requirements.
* Experience working directly with domestic and international mills and suppliers (particularly India and China) will be an added advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and database management.
* Strong communication, coordination, and organisational skills.
* Analytical and logical thinking with a proactive problem-solving approach.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment.
* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with cross-functional teams.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are particularly interested in candidates from the garment manufacturing, apparel, textile, and export house industries who have hands-on experience in fabric and trim sourcing and technical product development.

If you have a strong technical understanding of textiles, enjoy working with suppliers, and can efficiently manage the journey from material development to bulk production, we would love to hear from you.

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.**

* Support bank connectivity setup including SWIFT FIN/FileAct, Host-to-Host, SFTP, and API-based connectivity.
* Support integration of bank statements such as CAMT.05x, MT94x, and BAI2 with ERP and treasury systems for reconciliation.
* Prepare dashboards, operational reports, and status updates for liquidity, payments, reconciliation, and implementation progress.

* Exposure to SQL scripting, automation tools, and reporting scripts.
* Familiarity with Citrix environments and job scheduling tools.
* Understanding of electronic bank account management (eBAM) processes.

**Technical Expertise**

* Foreign Exchange (FX): trade capture, settlement, and valuation support.
* Interest Rate Swaps: configuration and lifecycle support.
* Forwards and Futures: hedging and exposure management support.
* Money Market Funds: investment workflow and reporting support.
* Derivatives and Options: pricing, risk analysis, and compliance support.
* Liquidity and Cash Positioning: ERP integration and dashboard support.

title: Ecotoxicologists - Agrochemicals for EU
description:
**Company Description**
Scientific Associates is a team of scientific and regulatory experts specializing in agrochemicals, with a strong focus on the European region. The organization acts as a one-stop solution provider for all agrochemical regulatory affairs, supporting clients through complex EU regulations. Scientific Associates is committed to delivering high-quality, science-driven solutions that align with industry standards and regulatory requirements. The company emphasizes cost-effective services tailored to fit diverse budgets, making robust regulatory support accessible to a wide range of clients.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time Ecotoxicologist – Agrochemicals for EU role based in the Greater Kolkata Area, structured as a hybrid/ Remote position with a mix of office and work-from-home days. The ecotoxicologist will design, review, and interpret ecotoxicological studies for agrochemical products in line with EU regulatory frameworks. Daily responsibilities include preparing risk assessments, drafting and reviewing regulatory dossiers, and providing scientific input on environmental fate and effects of agrochemicals. The role will involve close collaboration with internal regulatory teams and external laboratories, monitoring relevant EU guidance updates, and contributing to strategy for product registrations. The ecotoxicologist will also support clients by explaining technical findings, addressing regulatory queries, and helping optimize study designs to meet both scientific and regulatory expectations.

**Candidate Profile:**

Strong foundation in ecotoxicology, environmental sciences, or a related field, with the ability to design, analyze, and interpret ecotoxicological studies for agrochemicals. Knowledge of EU agrochemical regulatory frameworks (e.g., Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009), risk assessment methodologies, and relevant guidance documents.

• Preparation of study reports

• Monitoring of studies

• Preparation of study summaries of ecotoxicological (tier 1, higher-tier and open literature) studies

• Preparation of risk assessments in accordance with the EU and national requirements, including literature searches and information management

• Preparation of risk assessments for non-EU countries/regions

• Preparation of Completeness-checks und study lists

• Preparation of IUCLID dossier chapters

• Conducting data gap analyses, GAP evaluations and validity checks

• Completion of the entire Ecotoxicology Section

• Implementation and evaluation of questions in connection with BMD calculations
