title: Climate Resilience and Adaptation Advisor
description:
****Opportunity Type:****
Regular Fixed Term (Fixed Term)
  
  
****Summary:****
Position Summary
  
  
The Climate Resilience Advisor provides technical and advisory support to strengthen climate resilience of Habitat for Humanity’s housing and settlement work across Asia Pacific programs. The Advisor will work with the Asia-Pacific regional team to support Country Offices. This will include the implementation of strategic guidance, provision of technical assistance, design and delivery of capacity strengthening, supporting research, evidence-based implementation and knowledge management, advocacy and partnership development. This will include coordination with HFHI Global Program Operations, and specifically the Director-Climate Resilience (e.g., on development and implementation of the Global Climate Approach). The Advisor will work to ensure the integration of climate adaptation and mitigation into housing and settlement work and community development initiatives.
  
  
The Advisor will serve as the regional focal point for climate action, and in this capacity will support Country Offices to understand climate risks, and options to address/mitigate these risks to reduce vulnerability and build resilience of low- and middle-income households and communities across the Asia Pacific region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
**Key Result Areas and Responsibilities**

* Strategic Alignment and Stakeholder Engagement (30%)

Provide technical thought leadership to ensure climate resilient housing and settlement programming is aligned with the Global Climate Approach, with contextualized implementation across Country Offices in Asia Pacific region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Provide technical leadership to support contextualized/localized implementation and monitoring of HFHI’s Global Climate Approach within the Asia Pacific region.
* Advise on current/recent sources of climate risk data and analyses, and options for integrating climate these risks into housing/settlement-focused project design, implementation and monitoring.
* Facilitate alignment and promote integration between climate resilience programming and broader disaster risk reduction/humanitarian programming.
* Serve as a technical resource and thought partner to Habitat Country Offices, supporting program design, implementation and learning.
* Engage with external stakeholders (HFHI’s global and regional partners, research institutions, NGOs, and networks) to strengthen technical positioning and partnerships opportunities around climate resilience and DRR.
* Represent HFHI and contribute to relevant regional and global forums, working groups, and coordination platforms, as required.
* Support strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities that advance Habitat's climate resilience agenda.
* Capacity Building and Technical Support (25%)

Strengthen the technical capacity of Country Offices and partners to design, implement, and scale high-quality climate resilience housing/settlement programming
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
Assess in-country capacity, design and facilitate targeted capacity building initiatives (e.g., structured training, workshops, coaching) for National Organization staff on climate resilience.
  
  
Develop and maintain technical resources, tools, guidance documents, and learning materials.
  
  
Facilitate communities of practice, peer learning, and regional exchanges.
  
  
Promote organizational learning across countries, programs and operations.
  
  

* Technical Program Oversight (25%)

Provide advisory support to Country Offices to help ensure the quality of climate-related program design, implementation and monitoring. considerations into program designs, projects—supporting Country Offices to scale impact, and cross-learning across the Asia Pacific Region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Provide technical input and advisory support to Country Offices to strengthen integration of climate risk data/analyses and evidenced-based approaches into climate resilient housing/settlements project design, implementation and monitoring.
* Advise Country Offices on context specific adaptation measures, including resilient construction techniques, site selection, safer land use, and community-based approaches.
* Where feasible, advise Country Offices on context appropriate mitigation measures, where feasible,
* Contribute technical input to concept notes, program proposals, and donor reports related to climate resilience (e.g., adaptation and mitigation).
* As requested, support donor engagement resource mobilization efforts.
* Collaborate with other Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and technical teams to ensure climate considerations are integrated into cross-sectoral programming.
* Research, Innovation, Learning and Knowledge Management (15%)

Strengthen evidence generation, cross-learning and innovation, to improve climate resilient housing/settlement programming and support scaling of effective approaches.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Support research design and implementation, the generation and synthesis of evidence, and institutional learning specific to climate resilient housing.
* Document and share climate resilient housing/settlement promising practices, case studies, and lessons learned.
* Contribute to integration of climate and DRR indicators into MEAL systems and contribute to regional and global learning agendas.
* Contribute to research, support innovation pilots, and partnerships related to climate resilient housing and settlements.
* Develop and disseminate technical resources, and guidance materials.
* Provide subject matter expertise and technical advisory support to other departments and initiatives within HFHI.
* Disaster Preparedness, Response and Recovery Support (5%)

Provide advisory support to integrate climate risk reduction and resilience into disaster preparedness, response and recovery efforts
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
Work with the Housing Disaster Risk and Resilience (HDRR) team on climate risk reduction measures in response and recovery
  
  
Provide technical input on risk-informed approaches to recovery planning and implementation
  
  
Support alignment of recovery interventions with long-term resilience objectives
  
  
****Required Qualifications & Experience****

* Master’s degree in Climate Change, Environmental Sciences, Disaster Risk Reduction, Urban Planning, Engineering, Development Studies, or a related field
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience in climate resilience, DRR, or risk-informed programming, preferably in the Asia-Pacific region
* Demonstrated experience supporting multi-country programs and working with decentralized teams
* Strong understanding of climate risks, adaptation, and resilience approaches in housing, settlements, or community development
* Strong understanding of climate risks, adaptation, resilience, and mitigation approaches in housing, settlements, infrastructure, or community development.
* Experience in humanitarian, recovery, or nexus programming is an asset
* Experience in donor engagement, proposal development, or climate finance is an advantage

****Key Skills & Competencies****

* Strong technical expertise in climate adaptation and the built environment
* Sound understanding of climate mitigation, with the ability to understand where synergies and tradeoffs exist between mitigation and adaptation (especially where these impact affordability)
* Ability to translate technical concepts into practical, field-oriented guidance
* Proven advisory, facilitation, and capacity-building skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (regional languages an asset)
* Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills and ability to work in matrixed environments
* Willingness and ability to travel within the Asia-Pacific region

**Core Behavioral Competencies**

* Commitment to HFHI’s mission, values, equity, and safeguarding principles
* Collaboration and partnership mindset
* Learning oriented and solution focused
* Accountability and integrity

**Working Conditions**

* Regional role with frequent collaboration across multiple countries and time zones.
* Periodic travel to Country Offices and Country Offices, including fragile, climate-vulnerable, and disaster-affected contexts.
* Ability and willingness to travel within the Asia-Pacific region as required.

****About Us:****
Habitat for Humanity, founded in 1976, is a global, Christian-based nonprofit organization that grew out of an intentionally multi-racial community in rural Georgia. Seeking to put God’s love into action, Habitat brings together people of all faiths and people of no faith to build homes, communities and hope. Working alongside each other, we help families and individuals build and improve places to call home and achieve the strength, stability and self-reliance they need to build better lives for themselves. Habitat seeks individuals who have a willingness to affirm these principles and values.
  
  
At Habitat for Humanity International, we are compelled by our Koinonia roots to put God’s love for all into action and pursue housing equity and opportunity by bringing all people together to build community and drive impact. We strive to build a culture rooted in learning, accountability and trust, attracting and retaining mission-driven talent reflective of the global communities we serve.
  
  
****Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:****
As an equal opportunity employer, we realize our success depends on courageously committing to being a workplace where all staff feel safe, welcome, visible, respected, supported and valued, and building a workforce that reflects a variety of lived experiences, backgrounds and perspectives, in which every person experiences dignity and respect.

title: Associate Director- Protection & Control
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs is a global provider of technical, professional, and scientific services including engineering, architecture, construction, operations, and project management. Our portfolio spans industrial, commercial, and government clients across multiple markets and geographies. We have a PAN-India presence, with world-class engineering delivery centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata.
  
  
Challenging Today…Reinventing Tomorrow.
  
  
Jacobs is seeking a
**Associate Director- Protection & Control**
to support a range of high-profile projects across our Power & Energy portfolio. In this role, you will serve as a global Subject Matter Expert – Protection & Control, IEC 61850 & Digital Substations providing advanced technical leadership for protection and control engineering across substations, transmission and distribution systems, renewable interconnections, industrial power networks and digital grid infrastructure.
  
  
The SME will act as a technical authority for conventional, hybrid and fully digital substations, supporting projects across global markets including UK, Australia, Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific. The role requires deep domain expertise in protection schemes, relay settings, substation automation, IEC 61850 integration, SCADA interfaces, cybersecurity, commissioning support and future-ready digital substation technologies.
  
  
**The Primary Responsibilities Would Be**
**Protection & Control Engineering**

* Provide specialist technical leadership for protection and control design of medium voltage, high voltage and extra high voltage substations.
* Lead, review and technically assure protection schemes for

+ Line protection
+ Transformer protection
+ Busbar protection
+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection
+ SVC / STATCOM protection
+ Renewable and BESS interconnection protection
+ Industrial power network protection
+ Grid connection and interconnection protection

* Lead and review key engineering deliverables including

+ Protection Single Line Diagrams / Key Line Diagrams
+ Protection and control schematics
+ Control logic diagrams
+ Trip and alarm matrix
+ AC/DC auxiliary schematics
+ Panel GA and BOQ
+ Wiring diagrams

**About The Role**
The LTE RAN RF Planning Engineer is reliable for monitoring, optimising, and maintaining the RF performance of a private LTE network and associated wireless technologies used to help mission critical mining operations. This includes ensuring consistent coverage, mobility, and capacity for self-governing haulage, fleet communications, IoT sensors, control systems, CCTV, rail operations, and Cambium point to multipoint (PTMP) / point to point (PTP) wireless links distributed across the mine.
  
  
The role focuses on operational RF optimisation, performance troubleshooting, and helping deployment or relocation of LTE cells and Cambium nodes in dynamic mining environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage incidents and requests while maintaining high ticket quality and hygiene.
* Develop RF propagation and coverage models for open-pit mine environments using tools such as HTZ, Atoll, Mentum, or similar.
* Perform advanced root cause analysis for LTE outages.
* Maintain and manage LTE macro/small cell hardware (FDD) suitable for dynamic mining operations.
* Perform frequency optimization, PCI/RSI planning, link budgets, interference analysis, and EARFCN/channel allocation.
* Create RAN capacity plans aligned with AHS (Autonomous Haulage System), telemetry, CCTV, and IoT demands.
* Provide remote guidance to field teams performing RF surveys, antenna alignment, and LTE trailer moves.
* Use TEMS Pocket / TEMS Discovery for drive test data analysis (onsite teams), RSRP/SINR profiling, Layer 3 message decoding, handover investigations, and KPI trend analysis.
* Analyse LTE RAN performance KPIs including throughput, PRB utilisation, accessibility, retainability, and mobility metrics.
* Identify and resolve issues such as overshooting, coverage holes, interference, and imbalance.
* Produce optimisation recommendations such as power adjustments, tilt optimisations, parameter changes, and azimuth
* Conduct remote troubleshooting sessions with onsite teams, providing step by step diagnostic guidance.
* Manage and optimise Cambium PTP/PTMP backhaul links using tools such as Cambium HTZ/ LINKPlanner.
* Perform path profile studies, Fresnel zone checks, and availability modelling.
* Provide remote alignment assistance and configuration guidance to site teams.
* Work with Mining Technology, AHS, Fleet Management, and OT Automation teams to understand coverage/performance needs, adjust designs for pit progression and mine expansion, and ensure stable connectivity for trucks, drills, shovels, LV, and IoT devices
* Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes
* Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes.
* Prepare RF design documents, coverage heatmaps, network design packs, BOMs, and commissioning documentation.
* Support acceptance and integration testing remotely.
* Maintain version-controlled RF documents and change logs.
* Design LTE and wireless systems for high reliability in remote industrial environments.
* Ensure designs comply with mining standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational safety guidelines.
* Consider resilience, redundancy, and harsh environmental factors when developing plans.
* Manage and upkeep of NetAct server and software.

**Technical Skills Needed**

* Minimum 3–5+ years of LTE RAN planning, RF engineering, or optimisation experience.
* Experience with Private LTE / 5G SA networks in industrial deployments.
* Experience with common GIS applications eg: Global mapper,ArcGIS
* Knowledge of mining technologies (AHS, fleet management, dispatch systems).
* Networking knowledge: VLANs, routing, backhaul design, QoS.
* Scripting or automation (Python, SQL) for performance reporting is advantageous.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.

Rotational shifts of 24x7
  
  

* Preferred:
* LTE/RAN certification (nokia,Ericsson,Cisco)
* Cambium certification desirable
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* Strong understanding of LTE RAN concepts (EPC/E-UTRAN architecture, PCI planning, SINR/RSRP/TA, VoLTE, CA, etc.).
* Hands on experience analysing drive test data using TEMS Investigation or TEMS Discovery.
* Experience with RF planning tools (Atoll, HTZ, Planet, Mentum, iBwave).
* Experience with Cambium Networks (PTP 670/700, PMP 450i/450m,CnMaestro, cnWave, etc.).
* Strong analytical background in interpreting logs, KPIs, layer 3 messages, and RF statistics.
* Experience in ticketing-tools like Service Now, and exposure to ITIL processes in context of service operations is a plus.
* Experience supporting remote sites (mining/oil & gas/utilities) is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively with field teams from a remote location.

Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
  
  
**Position Title:**
Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance & Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
  
  
**Function:**
Insurance
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Conversion SME will own the end-to-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life & Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
**Conversion Strategy & Governance**

* Define the end-to-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big-bang vs. phased/wave-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.

**Business & Technical Bridge**

* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source-of-truth calculations.
* Lead root-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.

**Data Mapping & Rules Definition**

* Author functional specifications for field-level, transaction-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims-in-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.

**Testing & Reconciliation**

* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy-level and aggregate-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

Must-Have Skills
  
  
**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
9
  
  
**Platform**
Hands-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
  
  
**Conversion-specific**
Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
  
  
**Data**
Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
  
  
**Documentation**
Ability to write field-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting-grade standards
  
  
**Delivery**
Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
  
  
**Regulatory**
Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross-domain flexibility)

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards, along with practical experience in openEHR template/archetype design, healthcare data mapping, terminology mapping, and interface validation.
  
  
This role requires someone who can contribute not only as an individual contributor but also support solutioning, technical design, team guidance, and stakeholder discussions. The candidate should be able to work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, validate, and improve scalable healthcare interoperability solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and contribute to the design, development, and implementation of healthcare interoperability solutions and platforms.
* Work with HL7 FHIR, openEHR, and HL7 v2 standards to design and implement healthcare data exchange workflows.
* Design, review, and maintain openEHR templates, archetypes, and clinical data models based on clinical and business requirements.
* Perform healthcare data mapping, transformation, and validation across different standards and source systems.
* Support terminology and concept mapping activities, including mapping of clinical concepts, codes, and value sets.
* Conduct interface testing, API testing, payload validation, and compliance checks against agreed specifications and standards.
* Participate in and drive solutioning, technical design, and architecture discussions for interoperability use cases.

title: Enterprise Platform Advisor
description:
**Project Role :**
Enterprise Platform Advisor
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provide consulting services and advice on complex enterprise transformations involving one or more technology platforms. Advise on platform selection, technology cost optimization and/or value levers. Develop and implement market-leading industry- and/or function-specific technology assets.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Change Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Change Management – Analyst
  
  
Summary: As a Change Management Analyst, you will support clients through the organizational, cultural and workforce shifts that come with large platform-led transformation. You will work as part of a change workstream on a live client programme - running stakeholder and change impact analysis, building communications and learning assets, tracking readiness and adoption, and helping business teams get ready for new ways of working.
  
  
You will be expected to deliver your own tasks independently, with guidance from a consultant or Change Lead, and to grow steadily into a subject matter expert in one or more change capabilities. This role offers strong consulting foundations, industry exposure and hands-on experience with AI-enabled change accelerators.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  
Change strategy, impact and readiness
  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and maintain stakeholder maps, engagement plans and RACI views for assigned business units or geographies.
  
  
Run change impact assessments - capture process, system, role and behaviour changes, and translate them into practical mitigation actions.
  
  
Support business readiness tracking through readiness criteria, checklists, surveys and pulse checks ahead of each deployment wave.
  
  
Contribute to change strategy documents, change plans, case-for-change narratives and leadership alignment material.
  
  
Communications and engagement
  
  
Draft and produce change communications - emails, newsletters, intranet and Viva Engage posts, FAQs, leadership messages, posters and videos - aligned to the approved communication plan and client brand.
  
  
Maintain the communications calendar, manage approvals and track distribution and reach.
  
  
Support change champion and super-user networks: onboarding material, toolkits, forums, recognition and feedback loops.
  
  
Help plan and run engagement moments such as town halls, roadshows, demo days, floor walks and adoption campaigns.
  
  
Learning and enablement
  
  
Support training needs analysis and role-to-course mapping for impacted user groups.
  
  
Develop end-user enablement assets - job aids, quick reference cards, e-learning storyboards, simulations, how-to videos and instructor decks.
  
  
Coordinate training logistics, LMS uploads, attendance tracking, train-the-trainer sessions and post-training feedback.
  
  
Support hyper care and floor-walking activity around go-live and capture recurring user issues for resolution.
  
  
Adoption, analytics and AI accelerators
  
  
Use generative AI, agentic AI and other change accelerators to improve the speed, quality and personalization of change deliverables.
  
  
Track readiness, adoption, sentiment and proficiency metrics using digital adoption platforms, usage telemetry and survey tools.
  
  
Build and refresh adoption dashboards and status reports highlight trends, risk areas and recommended interventions.
  
  
Support value measurement by linking adoption data to programme benefits and business outcomes.
  
  
Delivery, governance and teaming
  
  
Own assigned deliverables end to end - quality, version control, client review cycles and on-time completion.
  
  
Maintain change trackers, RAID logs, governance packs and weekly or monthly status reporting for the change workstream.
  
  
Collaborate with business, functional, technical, deployment and PMO teams to keep change activity aligned to programme milestones.
  
  
Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, templates and internal knowledge sharing for the practice.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must have
  
  
Core Change Management
  
  
Change Impact & Business Readiness
  
  
Training & Learning Transformation
  
  
Change Communications & Engagement
  
  
Enterprise Platform Transformation exposure – SAP (including S/4HANA and SuccessFactors), Microsoft, Oracle, UKG or Workday
  
  
Strong written English, PowerPoint and Excel capability
  
  
Change PMO / Governance
  
  
Good to have
  
  
Agentic AI & AI Adoption (including Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement)
  
  
Change Analytics / Digital Adoption platforms (e.g. WalkMe, Viva Insights, Power BI)
  
  
PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification
  
  
Exposure to project management methodologies (Agile, waterfall, hybrid)
  
  
Creative design tools for communications, video and survey design
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  
Experience: 2-4 years of relevant change management experience
  
  
Locations: Bengaluru, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Noida
  
  
Education: 15 years of full-time education graduate degree or equivalent, MBA/PGDM preferred
  
  
Certification: PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification preferred
  
  
Mobility: May require mobility to client locations across India
  
  
Soft Skills required: Structured thinking, Communication, Storytelling, Collaboration, Adaptability, Ownership, Flexibility

+ Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
+ Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
+ Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.
+ Experience working in engineering, industrial, operational, or multi site business environments.

Candidates with a technical background and a good understanding of networking equipment, IT hardware, and active and passive networking infrastructure will be preferred.

To provide technical application support for electric motors and related products by understanding customer requirements, selecting suitable motor solutions, preparing technical and commercial proposals, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful execution of customer requirements.

**Minimum Requirements:**

**Education:**
B.Tech - Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.

:

* Proficiency in MS Office Applications (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and PowerPoint) is required.

* Understanding of competition and their strong/weak points are required. Knowledge of LV WMEMI motors products, including product scopes.
* Moderate understanding of Project Management for Business Developments.
* **Experience**
  : Minimum 5-7 Years of Experience in motor manufacturing order booking and billing, skilled in ERP, invoicing, compliance, logistics, dispatches and customer coordination.

**Travel Required:**
Occasional local travel as required for coordination with customer offices, warehouses, or plant locations.

Nil

On-site work required, remote work not applicable

title: Manual Quality Assutance Engineer with Data Exp
description:
👋 Greetings, future tech savant:
  
  
Embark on a vital journey into the realm of quality assurance and data integrity with 3Pillar! We extend an invitation for you to join our team and gear up for a crucial mission. At 3Pillar, our commitment is to ensuring the highest quality in cutting-edge technologies that revolutionize industries. As a Data Quality Analyst, you'll play an indispensable role in our dynamic team, ensuring that our innovative clinical trial projects and data systems meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and accuracy.
  
  
This opportunity goes beyond traditional testing; it's about being a guardian of excellence and a catalyst for delivering flawless data products that leave a lasting impression in the market. If your dedication to perfection, sharp analytical skills, and keen eye for detail fuel your drive to make a real-world impact, consider this your pass to the captivating world of Product Development! 🚀💻
  
  
Desired Capabilities:
  
  

* Understanding of product roadmap, business goals, and customer needs
* Ability to prioritize testing efforts based on business impact and clinical requirements
* Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills with high detail orientation
* Effective time management, organizational skills, and ability to work under pressure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills across all levels of team members, stakeholders, and customers
* Collaborative mindset to work effectively with cross-functional teams

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Testing Strategy & Execution: Develop and oversee the execution of comprehensive testing strategies to validate data reports, exports, and end-of-study deliverables.
* Requirements & Protocol Consistency: Ensure report requirements and data transfer specifications are clear, testable, proofread, and consistent with clinical trial protocols.
* Data Entry & Test Cases: Perform accurate data entry with a focus on generating both positive and negative test cases to ensure comprehensive coverage of system validation scenarios.
* Data Mapping & Verification: Execute qualification testing on data mapping/exports and verify customer data clarification requests.
* Defect Tracking & Documentation: Document and track defects to resolution while ensuring all testing adheres to applicable processes and procedures.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster effective communication and collaboration with developers, product managers, and stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or needed.

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Education / Experience: Associate degree or equivalent experience in software quality assurance, data testing, or related fields.
* Technical Skills:
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
* Basic SQL knowledge.
* Process & Tool Knowledge: Experience with defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA) and adhering to structured test documentation processes.
* Communication: Exceptional English communication skills (written and verbal), ensuring clear and effective exchange with personnel at various levels.
* Personal Attributes: Detail-oriented, self-motivated, with strong organizational and prioritization skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

Additional Experience Desired:
  
  

* Experience with Salesforce, SAS, or Python is a plus.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Knowledge of clinical trial protocols, data transfer specifications, or regulatory compliance standards.

What is it like working for 3Pillar Global?
  
  
At 3Pillar, we offer a world of opportunity:
  
  

* Imagine a flexible work environment – whether it's the office, your home, or a blend of both. From interviews to onboarding, we embody a remote-first approach.
* You will be part of a global team, learning from top talent around the world and across cultures, speaking English every day. Our global workforce enables our team to leverage global resources to accomplish our work in efficient and effective teams.
* We’re big on your well-being – as a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on wellbeing. Whether it is taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we want all of our team members operating at their best.
* Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities - across projects, offerings, and industries.
* We are an equal opportunity employer. It goes without saying that we live by values like Intrinsic Dignity and Open Collaboration to create cutting-edge technology AND reinforce our commitment to diversity - globally and locally.

title: SAP FI-DRC - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP FI-DRC - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**The Team**
Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting team helps organizations align tax, finance, and technology to support operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. The team works with clients to design and implement technology-enabled solutions across tax reporting, process transformation, and SAP-led modernization initiatives. Professionals in this practice collaborate across tax, finance, and technology functions to help clients address complex business and compliance needs.
  
  
As part of Deloitte Tax in India, you will work with multinational clients to address statutory reporting, e-invoicing, and finance process requirements in an evolving global tax environment. This role offers the opportunity to support complex implementations, collaborate across stakeholders, and contribute to large-scale tax technology initiatives.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a
**Senior, Tax Technology Services**
on the Tax Technology Consulting team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Supporting the implementation of statutory reporting solutions in SAP environments
* Supporting the implementation of e-invoicing solutions for client tax and finance operations
* Gathering business and functional requirements from clients and translating them into implementation support activities
* Coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to support solution design, testing, and deployment
* Contributing to SAP finance transformation initiatives involving financial posting processes and tax-related operational requirements

**Location: All Locations**
**Shift Timings: Regular hours**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience with SAP S/4HANA, or participation in 3 full lifecycle SAP implementations
* Experience supporting global template preparation and rollout activities
* Experience configuring or supporting SAP Finance (FI) processes including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Electronic Bank Statement, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders
* Experience supporting Procure to Pay, Record to Report, and Order to Cash processes
* Experience working with SAP Finance (FI), Controlling (CO), and integration with Sales and Distribution (SD) and Materials Management (MM)
* Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP)
* Experience supporting change requests, enhancements, or functional improvements in SAP Finance and Controlling environments

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions
* Experience with statutory reporting and e-invoicing implementations
* Experience with European Union tax business processes
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with multiple stakeholder groups
* Experience supporting SAP Finance and Controlling initiatives as an individual contributor or team lead

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: Food Technologist
description:
**Company Description**
Spoonfool is a cereal-focused food company committed to making high-quality, great-tasting breakfast products. The team combines food science, sensory expertise, and careful ingredient selection to deliver cereals that meet modern consumer expectations for flavor, texture, and consistency. The company emphasizes innovation in recipes and production methods to continuously improve its product range. Spoonfool offers an environment where food professionals can contribute to product development that reaches a broad consumer base. Team members collaborate closely across functions to turn cereal concepts into reliable products on store shelves.
  
**Role Description**
The Food Technologist at Spoonfool will support the development, testing, and improvement of cereal products from concept to scale-up. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting sensory evaluations, performing laboratory analyses, and collaborating with R&D to optimize formulations and processing conditions. The role involves monitoring quality control parameters, documenting test results, and ensuring that products meet safety and regulatory standards. The Food Technologist will work closely with production teams to troubleshoot issues, validate process changes, and help maintain consistent product quality. This is a contract position and a hybrid role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with regular on-site work at facilities and some work-from-home flexibility for documentation, data analysis, and planning tasks.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Food Technology and cereal product development.
* Hands-on Laboratory Skills, including sample preparation, analytical testing, and data recording.
* Experience with Sensory Evaluation methods and panel coordination.
* Knowledge of Quality Control processes for food manufacturing and familiarity with safety and regulatory standards.
* Background in Research and Development (R&D), including formulation trials and process optimization.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Food Technology, Food Science, or a related discipline.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid setup within the Kolkata metropolitan area, including time on the production floor.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accurate documentation.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional work with R&D, quality, and production teams.
* Experience in cereal or grain-based products is an advantage.

title: Tender Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
SINHOP ENGINEERING CONSULTANTS PRIVATE LIMITED is an engineering consultancy firm headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The registered office is located at Unit 3 B Girindra Cooperative Housing Society Limited,Prantik Pally Kasba, Kolkata – 700107. The company provides professional engineering and consulting services to a range of clients, with an emphasis on quality, reliability, and technical expertise. SINHOP maintains accessible communication channels through its office contact number and dedicated email, supporting responsive client service and project coordination. The organization offers opportunities for engineering professionals to work on diverse projects in a structured and collaborative environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Tender Engineer is responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering process for engineering and consultancy projects in an on-site, full-time role based in Kolkata. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying relevant tenders, reviewing tender documents and technical specifications, and coordinating with internal teams to gather technical, commercial, and legal inputs. The role involves preparing comprehensive bid proposals, cost estimates, BOQs, and supporting documentation, while ensuring compliance with client requirements and applicable standards. The Tender Engineer will track submission deadlines, participate in pre-bid meetings and clarifications, and support post-submission follow-ups, negotiations, and documentation. The position also includes maintaining tender databases, updating management on tender status, and contributing to process improvements for efficient bid management.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong technical background in engineering (civil, mechanical, electrical, or related discipline) with the ability to understand drawings, specifications, and project scopes.
* Experience in tendering, bid preparation, estimation, and costing for engineering or infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with estimation or tender management software tools.
* Solid understanding of contract terms, procurement processes, and regulatory or compliance requirements relevant to engineering tenders.
* Effective communication, documentation, and presentation skills, with the ability to coordinate inputs from cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in calculations and proposals.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, manage multiple tenders simultaneously, and meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering or a related field; prior experience in a tendering or proposals role will be considered an advantage.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**

We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.

**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.

title: Specialist - Application Security
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. Making an impact.

* The Specialist in this position will plan and deliver web, API and mobile VAPT engagements within agreed scope, quality and timelines
* You will perform manual and automated testing; validate findings and eliminate false positives
* And rate vulnerabilities using OWASP, CWE and CVSS, considering exploitability and business impact
* Also, document reproducible evidence, proof-of-concept steps and practical remediation actions

title: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1_2+yrs
description:
**Job Description**
: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1
  
  
**Position:**
Microsoft 365 / O365 L1 Support Engineer
  
  
**Number of Openings:**
8 Resources
  
  
**Experience:**
1–3 Years (Preferred)
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services. The ideal candidates should have basic knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune, along with strong troubleshooting, ticket management, and customer service skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Support: Provide L1 support for Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* User and Access Management: Handle user account creation, password resets, license assignments, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
* Intune Support: Assist with device onboarding, enrollment, configuration, and basic Microsoft Intune-related issues.
* Outlook and Exchange Troubleshooting: Resolve basic Outlook connectivity, mailbox access, email delivery, and shared mailbox issues.
* Teams Support: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams login issues, audio/video calling problems, and basic collaboration-related queries.
* SharePoint and OneDrive Support: Assist users with SharePoint access, OneDrive synchronization, file-sharing permissions, and basic application issues.
* Mailbox and Distribution List Management: Manage shared mailbox requests, distribution lists, and user access requests according to approved processes.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Log, track, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs. Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.
* Ticket Documentation: Maintain accurate ticket updates, troubleshooting records, resolution notes, and knowledge-base articles.
* User Communication: Provide timely updates to end users, follow established support procedures, and ensure a positive user experience.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT helpdesk, service desk, or Microsoft 365 support.
* Basic hands-on knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Understanding of user account management, password resets, license assignment, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Intune and device enrollment processes.
* Familiarity with Outlook troubleshooting, mailbox access, email delivery, and Teams connectivity issues.
* Experience using ticketing tools and working within SLA-driven support environments.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Active Directory fundamentals.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and incident management.
* Microsoft 365 Fundamentals certification (MS-900) or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience working in a structured IT service desk or enterprise support environment.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A customer-focused IT support professional capable of resolving routine Microsoft 365 issues, managing user access requests, documenting incidents accurately, and escalating complex technical problems to the appropriate support teams.

title: SAP FICA Functional-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Career Family: SAP Utilities**
**Role Type: Functional Consultant**
**The opportunity**
As part of our EY GDS-Utilities team, you will work to implement and support SAP IS-U projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problems.
  
  
We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in
**SAP FI-CA**
to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* To provide functional knowledge with hands-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)
* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc.
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning procedure/Collection Strategy, payment (cash desk/external cash desk) integration with payment channels, write off, return processing, security deposit, installment plan, and promise to pay.
* Exposure of Country specific localization.
* Experience in BRIM CI FICA is good to have.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF+ (functional).
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support.
* Gather and prioritize relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests
* Should be well versed to make enhancements in specific FICA events.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:

+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tendering Specialist
description:

operates in a dynamic, project-driven environment that requires careful planning, documentation, and coordination with multiple stakeholders. The organization focuses on delivering competitive, compliant proposals and tenders for a variety of contracts and clients. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work, maintain high professional standards, and contribute to process improvement. The work culture values reliability, attention to detail, and clear communication across functions to support successful bids and long-term partnerships.

The Tendering Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. title: Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their organizational structures and processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will focus on aligning organizational structures with strategic goals, driving long-term success for our clients. As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor junior team members, and maintain professional standards. You will build meaningful client relationships and develop a deeper understanding of the business context, navigating complex situations to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deliver tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth. You will collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver training needs analysis, curriculum design, and blended training solutions, using industry-standard tools to create engaging learning assets. Your ability to adapt to changing priorities and work across time zones will validate seamless project execution and client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing and implementing learning solutions to support client transformation initiatives
* Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to conduct Training Needs Analysis and develop curriculum
* Utilizing instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE and SAM to create engaging learning experiences
* Developing role-based learning plans and blended training solutions tailored to client needs
* Leveraging industry-standard authoring tools like Articulate Storyline and Adobe Captivate to create multimedia learning assets
* Publishing and managing content on Learning Management Systems, confirming accessibility standards are met
* Evaluating learning program effectiveness using Kirkpatrick Levels 1-3 and refining based on feedback
* Supporting engagement delivery through phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation
* Facilitating workshops and presentations using various collaboration tools
* Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to enhance their development
* Staying informed on the latest trends in learning and development to contribute to internal initiatives
* Developing and presenting innovative ideas and solutions to clients and stakeholders
* Building and maintaining client relationships to support organizational change management efforts
* Analyzing business operations and ERP solutions to align learning strategies with organizational goals

What You Must Have
  
  

* 4-8 years of prior relevant experience in consulting
* Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education (M.Ed.), Communications, HR, Organizational Development or Psychology.
* Certification in Instructional Design or Learning Experience Design (e.g., ATD/CPTD, Articulate, or an equivalent recognized ID credential) is required, while PROSCI or other Change Management certifications are preferred and considered an added advantage.
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity.
* Demonstrating proficiency in AI tools for workforce solutions
* Utilizing analytical thinking to assess training effectiveness
* Collaborating with engagement managers to address client needs
* Exhibiting ability to work independently and in teams
* Supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring juniors
* Leveraging AI-human collaboration for enhanced productivity
